name: projectstore
description: Your agent runs the project through a verified loop: task → artifact (ADR / spec / epic / story) → adversarial critic → backlog → planner → reviewer → done. Plain markdown in git — any model can pick the project up tomorrow.

scripts.release:check: npm run adapters:check && npm run guard && npm run shells:check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.lint: node tools/lint/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --max-warnings 0 bin scripts "hooks/*.mjs" "packaging/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.mjs" eslint.config.mjs tools/lint/eslint.config.mjs tools/lint/setup-check.mjs
scripts.format: node tools/lint/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write bin scripts "hooks/*.mjs" "packaging/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.mjs" eslint.config.mjs tools/lint/eslint.config.mjs tools/lint/setup-check.mjs
scripts.format:check: node tools/lint/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check bin scripts "hooks/*.mjs" "packaging/**/*.mjs" "tests/**/*.mjs" eslint.config.mjs tools/lint/eslint.config.mjs tools/lint/setup-check.mjs
